statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: delete in v1.0.0 with AWS_LABEL_MIGRATIONS. Principals owned only by an out-of-scope AWSAccount written before load() stamped _module_name. Any account a current sync still references is re-stamped by load(), so these are unreachable.
statements.query: MATCH (a:AWSAccount) WHERE a._module_name IS NULL AND coalesce(a.inscope, false) = false AND a.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)--(m) WHERE m._module_name IS NOT NULL } MATCH (a)-[:RESOURCE]->(child) WHERE child._module_name IS NULL WITH child LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE child
